questions.q: A megacity is a city with a population of more than...
Counter-urbanisation is the movement of people...
options: from the inner city to the suburbs
questions.why: Counter-urbanisation means people leaving the city for the countryside.

questions.q: Why is land most expensive in the CBD?
options: it is the cheapest to build on
it is the most accessible, so competition for space is highest
questions.why: High accessibility means many customers, so businesses compete and bid up land values.

questions.q: Explain two ways rapid urbanisation can cause housing challenges.
questions.model: Migrants arrive faster than homes are built, causing shortages and high rents; poor migrants build squatter settlements without water, sanitation or electricity.
points: housing shortage/overcrowding because migrants arrive faster than building
lack of services or health problems
